## Story / issue

Link the GitHub issue or story this change implements.

## What changed

Describe the implementation in concrete terms.

## Why

Explain the business or technical reason for the change.

## GIS impact

If applicable, document:
- dataset/file-format impact,
- coordinate reference system assumptions,
- spatial/data validation changes,
- downstream integration impact.

## Verification

- [ ] Automated tests added or updated where needed
- [ ] `mvn clean verify` passes
- [ ] Acceptance criteria checked
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated
- [ ] Canon/tracker updated if this introduces permanent world facts

## Risk / rollback

Describe meaningful risks and how the change could be reverted or disabled.
